== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Path]] of the [[Dawn Oath]] is a specialized set of [[sacred arts]] utilized by [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]], the [[Archlord]] of the [[Dawnwing Sect]]. This [[Path]] is an offshoot of the [[Rune Queen]] [[Emala]]'s [[Path of Last Oath|Path of the Last Oath]] and consists of only two techniques. A primary component of this [[Path]] is the [[Oathsign]] technique, which allows the user to forge glowing green runes in circular patterns. These [[scripts]] can be used for various defensive purposes, such as creating concentric circles to resist physical force, [[madra]], or specific elemental auras like [[storm aura]]. Additionally, the [[Path]] enables the user to channel power beyond their own spirit, provided they have a sufficient foundation. Because of its defensive capabilities, the [[Path]] is well-suited for a [[Shield Sage]].}}
